root_cause.explanation: The independently reconstructed candidates use the same frozen bucket assignments for both metrics. Their valid residual vectors reverse order because squared L2 favors more dispersed smaller residuals while L1/TV favors less total displaced mass despite a larger peak residual. Boundary crossings affect the residual vectors, but no separate bucket or pair aggregation path exists between SSE and TE, so aliasing is not the primary cause of their mutual reversal.
